instructions: Draw exactly what is listed here and nothing else. Palette: cream background, deep forest green and brass accents, dark ink text. No brand logos, no bottle designs, no prices, no numbers other than the rank numbers given for fig-02.

fig-01.layout: Two side-by-side panels on top, one full-width strip underneath, one footer line.

panels.heading: Fashion house
panels.label: Perfume is one thing it sells among many

fig-01.footer: Pick the notes you like, then try a small bottle first.

fig-02.title: Where the eleven sit: a niche scent map
fig-02.point_label_format: rank number, then name (for example: 1. Creed Aventus)
fig-02.caption: Placements are Base Note's reading of each manufacturer's official notes, not a lab measurement.

points.name: Creed Aventus
points.reason: Bergamot, lemon and blackcurrant leaf on top keep it on the fresh side; a pineapple accord and pink pepper in the heart and birch, patchouli and musk in the base add body, so it sits near the middle.

points.name: Parfums de Marly Layton
points.reason: Apple, bergamot and lavender give a fresh opening, but a base of vanilla, praline, patchouli and guaiac wood pulls it warm and moderately rich.

points.name: Xerjoff Alexandria II
points.reason: Cinnamon and rosewood on top, Bulgarian rose in the heart and a base of amber, Laotian oud, sandalwood and vanilla make it warm and rich.

points.name: Creed Green Irish Tweed
points.reason: Peppermint, verbena, lemon and galbanum make it fresh and green; sandalwood, cedarwood, ambroxan and oakmoss in the base give it a medium body.

points.name: Bond No. 9 Bleecker Street
points.reason: Violet leaf, cassis and thyme on top are green, but cinnamon in the heart and suede, amber, patchouli and vanilla in the base make it warm and fairly rich.

points.name: Parfums de Marly Perseus
points.reason: Bergamot and grapefruit on top with geranium and blackcurrant bud keep it fresh and light; vetiver, amberwood and grey amber give it a light woody base.

points.name: Bond No. 9 The Scent of Peace for Him
points.reason: Bergamot, pineapple and juniper berry on top are fresh; cedarwood and vetiver in the heart and patchouli, moss, musk and amber in the base add moderate weight.

points.name: Tom Ford Oud Wood
points.reason: Official key notes of cardamom, pink pepper, patchouli, amber, oud and tonka bean, described as a smoky blend of oud, sandalwood and vetiver, place it warm and rich.

points.name: Initio Side Effect
points.reason: Main notes of cinnamon, rum, tobacco, saffron and sandalwood, classified by Initio as ambery and spicy, make it the warmest and richest point on the map.

points.name: Parfums de Marly Pegasus
points.reason: Anise, bergamot and almond on top with cypress and violet leaves in the heart keep it lighter than Layton; the vanilla, sandalwood and ambrox base makes it warm.

points.name: Creed Silver Mountain Water
points.reason: Bergamot, blackcurrant, galbanum and orange on top, tea and an ozonic accord in the heart and only musk and sandalwood in the base make it the freshest and lightest point.
